## Kind of change

- [ ] Editorial (no change to what conforms)
- [ ] Normative, compatible
- [ ] Normative, breaking
- [ ] Tooling (validator, tests, scripts)

## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests` passes
- [ ] For a normative change: `SPEC.md`, the schema, an example or test, and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated together
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), certifying the [DCO](../DCO)
- [ ] Any material from another source is named here with its licence
- [ ] I know of no patent that covers what this change requires implementers to do, or I have described it below
